contentPattern.structure: audience tab labels + per-audience content panels

notes: Audience/interest tab selector switching between per-audience content panels (underline tab bar).

This variant's decorate() still relies on adjacent tab sections; the '.tabs-audience' CSS applies when the block root carries the 'tabs-audience' class. Reconcile the exact authoring model (section-tabs vs table-tabs) and createTabs wiring in the block-mapping / import-infrastructure step.
